mainEntity.name: How do I choose the right contractor for my basement finishing project?

acceptedAnswer.text: When choosing a contractor for basement finishing, look for one with local experience, proper licensing, and a strong portfolio of similar projects. Request references and review their track record. A good contractor should provide a clear contract, detailed estimates, and transparent communication throughout the process. Hometelligent, for example, prioritizes clear communication and project management for clients in Alameda, Albany, Berkeley, Dublin, and Emeryville.
